quirks: MISCLASSIFIED: registry name is 'Address Validator' but this backend URL (stableenrich.dev/api/hunter/email-verifier) is actually a Hunter-style EMAIL VERIFIER, not a postal-address validator. Send {email}, NOT an address.
Required body field is 'email' (single field). Sending an address/zip will fail schema validation.
Plain sync JSON response; no async, no auth, no templates.
Pay $0.03 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402; Solana mainnet also accepted.
usage.guide: Despite the 'Address Validator' name, this endpoint verifies EMAIL addresses. Call POST https://stableenrich.dev/api/hunter/email-verifier with JSON body {"email":"someone@example.com"} and pay $0.03 USDC on Base via x402. Read body.status (valid/invalid/accept_all/webmail/disposable/unknown) and body.score for the verdict, plus boolean signals like body.mx_records, body.smtp_check, body.disposable, body.webmail. Response is synchronous JSON. Do NOT send a postal address here.
